caption: The drawing depicts a figure centered within a rectangular frame bordered in dark red and brown hues. The figure is dressed in a dark brown cloak that forms a wide triangular shape and covers most of the body. The face is light in color, with basic facial features outlined in black, and the head is surrounded by a yellow and red halo made of radiating lines. The figure holds a rectangular cloth or panel in front of the torso featuring a stylized face with a crown of thorns, featuring black lines and a muted blue-green hue above the face. The background inside the frame consists of wavy, vertical shapes and lines in beige, light blue, pale yellow, pink, and black. The entire composition is surrounded by a secondary border of deep red. The numeral "20" appears in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Plate 20: Saint Veronica: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
